sections.name: GET
sections.title: Current user handler
sections.what: Returns the logged-in user's session data, or a 401 response when nobody is logged in.
sections.why: The app uses this to decide what to show.
sections.watch_out: Avoid storing secrets in the session, because this route sends the whole session back.

summary: Returns who is logged in, or a 401 error if no one is.
purpose: Lets the app check the current login state.
why: Likely reason: pages need to know who is signed in when they load.
how: Reads the session from the cookie. If there is none, returns a null user with status 401. Otherwise returns the session data as the user.
inputs: The login cookie sent by the browser.
outputs: The session data as the user, or a null user with status 401.
risks: Returns everything stored in the session, so anything placed there becomes visible to the browser.
debug: If a logged-in user sees null, check the cookie and the getSession helper in lib/session.
